scopes.name: redact
scopes.description: Redact text and documents, and explain redactions.

scopes.name: contexts:read
scopes.description: List and read contexts and their entries, including exports.

scopes.name: contexts:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete contexts and their entries, including imports.

scopes.name: policies:read
scopes.description: List and read policies, their versions, and diffs, and compile PhiSQL.

scopes.name: policies:write
scopes.description: Create, delete, and roll back policies.

scopes.name: lists:read
scopes.description: Read custom lists and the always/never redact lists.

scopes.name: lists:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete custom lists and the always/never redact lists.

scopes.name: documents:read
scopes.description: List asynchronous redaction jobs and download their results.

scopes.name: documents:write
scopes.description: Delete asynchronous redaction records.

scopes.name: ledger:read
scopes.description: List, read, and validate redaction ledger chains, without the redacted values.

scopes.name: ledger:export
scopes.description: Export a ledger chain, which carries the original values in the clear.

scopes.name: ledger:delete
scopes.description: Delete or purge ledger entries. Also requires an administrator.

scopes.name: holds:read
scopes.description: List and read legal holds.

scopes.name: holds:write
scopes.description: Place and release legal holds.

scopes.name: audit:read
scopes.description: Read the audit log. Also requires an administrator.

scopes.name: signing:write
scopes.description: Rotate the output signing key. Also requires an administrator.

scopes.name: users:read
scopes.description: List and read users. Also requires an administrator, except to read the calling key's own user.

scopes.name: users:write
scopes.description: Create users, set their role, password, and MFA, and deactivate or reactivate them. Also requires an administrator, except to change the calling key's own password and MFA.

scopes.name: api-keys:read
scopes.description: List API keys. Also requires an administrator for another user's keys.

scopes.name: api-keys:write
scopes.description: Create, re-scope, and revoke API keys. Also requires an administrator for another user's keys.

scopes.name: settings:read
scopes.description: Read the deployment's admin settings. Also requires an administrator.

scopes.name: settings:write
scopes.description: Change the deployment's admin settings. Also requires an administrator.

scopes.name: webhooks:read
scopes.description: Read a user's webhook URL and whether a secret is set.

scopes.name: webhooks:write
scopes.description: Set and remove a user's webhook URL and secret.

scopes.name: reidentify
scopes.description: Reverse a replacement to its original value.
